info.name: SchoolApi - End-to-End & Error Checking Tests
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman test collection for SchoolApi covering all controllers and endpoints:
- ClassRooms, Teachers, Students, Courses, Enrollments, and Reports
- Full CRUD operations, Transcripts, Rosters, Course Stats, Classroom Toppers, CSV Bulk Import, and Update Marks
- Happy paths, boundary checks, and error scenarios (400 Bad Request, 404 Not Found, 409 Conflict)
- Relational constraint verification (FK RESTRICT, duplicate keys, capacity overflow).

### Dependency Execution Order:
1. **ClassRooms (Parent)**: Create -> Read -> Update -> Error checks -> Temporary Delete check
2. **Teachers (Parent)**: Create -> Read -> Update -> Error checks -> Temporary Delete check
3. **Students (Child of ClassRoom)**: Create -> Read with Pagination/Search filters -> Parameter validation errors -> Update -> Unique constraint errors -> CSV Bulk Import -> Temporary Delete check
4. **Courses (Child of Teacher)**: Create -> Read -> Update -> Credit Hours & Capacity range errors -> Temporary Delete check
5. **Enrollments (Child of Student & Course)**:
   - Add Enrollment (Happy Path)
   - Update Marks (Happy Path & Errors: >100, <0, 404)
   - Add Enrollment Errors: Duplicate Student & Course (409), Non-existent Course (409), Non-existent Student (409), Invalid Data Type (400)
   - Capacity Overflow Verification (Capacity = 1)
6. **Transcripts & Rosters**:
   - Student Transcript (Happy Path & 404)
   - Course Roster (Happy Path & 404)
7. **Reports**:
   - Classroom Toppers (Happy Path & Error limit < 1)
   - Course Stats (Happy Path & 404)
8. **Relational Constraints**:
   - Delete Teacher while Course exists (409 Conflict)
   - Delete ClassRoom while Student exists (409 Conflict)
